unit.why: A single anecdote about the Seer of Lublin, who rebukes a man until he shames him and then apologizes, transmitted from the narrator's father.
unit.boundary_note: the trailing heading 'מענין בקשה מן הצדיקים' belongs to the next division; the heading 'מענין ביוש' that introduces this story sits at the end of the previous division

stories.start_quote: ד) שמעתי מא״א מו״ר זצל״ה שסיפר
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin rebukes a visitor so harshly that the man protests he is being shamed, and the rebbe apologizes because his words have failed to bring the man to repentance; the narrator adds that the apology itself may have been meant to move him to return.
